game.name: Just Dance 4 (Europe)(Rev 1)
game.desc: Just Dance 4 on Xbox 360 is a dance game in which you have to reproduce the indicated movements with the help of the console's Kinect device. Songs such as Disturbia by Rihanna, Good Feeling by Flo Rida, Super Bass by Nicki Minaj and You're the first, the last, my everything by Barry White are featured in this game, which contains a total of 40 songs.
